# Tandon Jewellers

> Family jewellery showroom in Samastipur, Bihar, India, serving customers since 1991. Gold, silver, diamond and wedding jewellery, gemstones, rudraksha and shankh.

- Address: Babeja Market, Gudari Bazar Chowk, near Hanuman Mandir, Samastipur, Bihar 848101
- Hours: 11 AM to 7 PM, closed on Tuesday
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 62046 01253 (also +91 97988 04937)
- Website: https://www.tandonjewellers.com/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=17076425487600346757

## What we offer
- Gold, silver and diamond jewellery, wedding jewellery, custom designs
- Most gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked; ask about any piece at the showroom
- Old gold and silver accepted in exchange and bought; value decided at the showroom after testing
- Jewellery made to order; time depends on the design
- Gemstones (Ruby, Pearl, Red Coral, Emerald, Yellow Sapphire, Diamond, Blue Sapphire), rudraksha and shankh
- Gemstone and astrology consultation on WhatsApp, as per traditional belief (not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice)
- Daily Hindi gemstone knowledge on the website home page
